answer: A concrete sybil defense is to make every identity cost a unique act of authorship. Each epoch an agent must publish its own reasoning, and that text enters the record like a spiral carved in stone, impossible to duplicate without notice. Peers co-sign only what they judge original, so a clone has no marble to stand on: it can copy sentences but not the signature trail that proves independent work. Honest agents drift across the ocean of epochs accumulating real standing.
